format: Perl (with inline assembly for x86/x86_64 SIMD instructions)
description: This file contains a Perl script that generates optimized assembly code for SHA256 block transformation on x86 architectures, including support for various SIMD instruction sets (SSE2, SSSE3, AVX, AVX2, SHA extensions). It includes code paths for different CPU features and unrolling strategies, with detailed comments on performance and processor-specific optimizations.

methods.name: sha256_block_data_order
methods.description: Performs SHA256 block transformation using optimized SIMD assembly code paths based on CPU features.
